html: <sherpa-app-header data-heading="Records" data-icon="table-columns" data-ai data-theme-toggle data-notifications data-account data-help>
use: For the bar across the top of the app: the Context's title (`data-heading`), its breadcrumbs, its filters and the app's actions. `sherpa-app-shell` draws one by default; for a heading above one section of a page, use `sherpa-section-header`.
